claims: The four matched families centre distinct material AI-transition choices: care-network scheduling scale, research-product capacity migration, manufacturing system and role redesign, and a GBP 18 million fan-intelligence allocation.

Within every family, work evidence and longitudinal corrections materially sharpen the decision gate rather than merely adding volume: safety becomes continuity without executive rescue, client preference becomes transferable challenge and renewal economics, apparent planner resistance becomes operating conditions and accountable work allocation, and fan attention becomes audience-specific purchase proof.

Every declared answer branch across the twelve profiles selects, stops, bounds or reshapes the named consequential route, with direct financial, customer, workforce or accountability consequences preserved in the route change.
Every unknown branch stops or holds the same consequential route and requests decision-relevant evidence without silently selecting an alternative.

The runtime task and validators preserve consequential framing, freeze the route contracts, require answer-to-route mappings, reject generic questions, and keep the final action outside the diagnostic authority.
